entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: *pant* *pant* Didn't realize those things[n]could be that tough...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah... It looks like he's making a[n]concerted effort to stop us now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Joker, I've helped you learn a few[n]different things so far, but there's[n]no more time for lessons.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'll compile some info you'll need to know[n]for battle, so be sure to take a look later.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Crap... More of 'em...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What should we do? Head back?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No, the Treasure is definitely up ahead,[n]and there has to be a path to it somewhere.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: See anything that could help us zip by here?[n]Keep your eyes sharp!
Ailments, Attribute Affinities, Rush,[n]and Skill Selection Assistance have been[n]added to the battle tutorial menu.
Tutorials you have seen before can be viewed[n]in the main menu. Press [f 1 10 25] to open the menu[n]and select [clr 2]System[clr 27], and then [clr 2]Tutorial[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's definitely something fishy over[n]there. There's vines growin' on the door too.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah. By the looks of it, no one's been in[n]there for a long time.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If only we had a way to get across...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm not seeing anything useful... It's too bad[n]we can't just jump across.
Is that...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What's up, Joker?
Time to use your little gift. Perfect time to
bust this out.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Huh? What're you— Oh, nice![n]It's grappling hook time!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That'll definitely get you across the gap[n]if you use it right, but where are you[n]gonna aim it?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Holy shit! Did you see that!? We were[n]all like, WHOOSHHH!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, I didn't even have time to get over[n]my surprise! That thing's super useful.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Nice moves, Joker! Heh, I knew you[n]were a natural at this!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If you ever see an area you can't reach[n]on your feet, that grappling hook might[n]be able to help you out!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Keep an eye out for anything that hook[n]could latch onto. This is a fundamental[n]aspect of phantom thievery, got it?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There he goes again...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Alright, let's check out that door.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Whew. that was close. Good going,[n]Joker! That was some expert grappling.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And now we can investigate this area![n]Let's get to it.
